compatibilityNotes: Kajüte (8x3) and Salzwatt (8x4) require separate Q_kajuete_tiles_v2 and S_salzwatt_tiles_v2 sheets: their cell meanings differ from R_innen (8x5) and R_vergessmoor (8x6).
FACADES are modular 128x96 8x6 tile sheets, not individual full-building sprites. Eighteen material/architecture variants retain the FACADES cell groups.
Four distinct water/fog phases are delivered in fx/wexmoor_v2_tileanim.png. Apply animationOverrides during integration; existing two-frame indices remain unchanged in the replacement atlas.
Only Wexmoor c_bahnhof maps should use C_bahnhof_wexmoor_v2. Kettlegate assets and runtime bindings remain unchanged.
